stations.title: Ivo
stations.say: It still says one place left!
stations.note: After he booked the last one.

stations.title: Studio API
stations.note: The front desk books by phone.

captions: Ivo booked the last place at Glazing basics to test the screen.
The card still offers one place, because the screen never heard back.
You take places from the server, catch up after a refusal, and keep the cards meanwhile.
Now the card turns full the moment the server says so.
Bookings here or at the front desk, the cards say what the server says.
